comment: PR-07: the node-level write path of the accessibility backend (ui.click / longClick / select / dismiss / scroll / setValue / setProgress / imeAction). Expectations come from an independent reading of upstream NodeActions; C#-only like the read vectors. World model: each root read is a fresh copy; performAction returns true for ids in "accepts" and then applies the node's "on" ops (rangeAdd by/dropAtEnd, rangeSet step [rounds the requested value], setText maxLen, toggle, setId, remove), each visible once the clock reaches dispatch + lagMs. The clock only moves in the delays the code asks for; endMs is where it ends. hostAtMs: from then on the root's package is the host's own. Consent controls are nodes of com.android.permissioncontroller. Range floats are float32; javaFloat locks Float.toString.
